title: Tourist Season, 2008
logline: The coastal weekly runs the strip; the tourists now read it in the paper at Gully's and then look up. Wood has to be somewhere else in August.

panels.composition: Gully's, August. Three TOURISTS with the weekly open to page fourteen, looking from the strip to the room. The end stool empty.

characters.pose: three, with the paper, looking around

image.prompt: three tourists at a bait-shop counter holding a local weekly open to a comic page and looking around the room, an empty stool at the end, a man in an apron answering in one word, muddy flats

panels.composition: The beach, far end. WOOD and BARNABY on the drift log. Nobody. The pad.

image.prompt: a thin man and an old dog on a bleached drift log at the far end of an empty beach, a drawing pad, no words

panels.composition: The pad: Gully at the counter, three tourists, the empty stool, drawn from memory, exactly.

image.prompt: close-up of a drawing pad with a sketch of a shop counter, three tourists and an empty stool

panels.composition: Evening. Wood walking back up the beach. Gully's chimney. The strip he'll post tomorrow is the one he drew about not being there.

image.prompt: a thin man and a dog walking back up a beach at evening toward a distant shingle shack's chimney smoke, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; Sundays the point

notes: August: he's out. The strip about not being there.
